name: when-field
description: A day, or a day and a time, written the way a person says it: 19 Sep, next Friday, tomorrow 2pm. The platform's own date picker stands beside the words for anyone who would rather look at a month, and picking a day writes it into them.

use.when: asking for when something is, due or happens.
use.not: a day that must be picked from a month and never typed, which is the datepicker.
use.with: a hint, which is always shown, with an example of what can be typed.

value.description: The day as a person reads it, such as Fri 2 Oct 2026 14:00.

day.description: The same day as YYYY-MM-DD, so the picker opens on it.

hint.default: A day, like 19 Sep or next Friday, with a time if there is one, like 2pm.

a11y.role: textbox, with a date picker beside it once scripts run

keyboard.does: moves from the words to the picker and on
in the picker, changes the part under the cursor
in the picker, opens the platform's calendar

wcag.notes: Typing a day is the fastest way for most people and the only way for some; the picker is there for the rest. The hint says what can be typed and is tied to the field (3.3.2); an error is tied to it too (3.3.1). The picker is hidden until scripts run, since without them it could not write into the words.

machine.identify: input.sw-field__input[type=text] holds the words that are sent; input[type=date] is the picker, which sends nothing itself.
machine.operate: Type a day into the text field, such as 2026-10-02 or next Friday 2pm; the server reads it.

props.label: Deadline
props.name: deadline
props.error: Say a day, like 19 Sep or next Friday.
